name: Upwork MCP Server
description: Lets Upwork clients and freelancers use a hosted OAuth MCP server to draft job posts, search and invite freelancers, write proposals, and manage offers and contracts.

skills.name: Job Post Drafting
skills.description: Turns a rough project brief into a reviewed Upwork job post, then publishes, updates, or closes it.

skills.name: Freelancer Hiring
skills.description: Searches freelancers, reviews proposals, shortlists and invites candidates, and prepares contract offers.

skills.name: Proposal Writing
skills.description: Researches a job and the freelancer's real work history to draft a tailored proposal for review and submission.

skills.name: Contract And Milestone Tracking
skills.description: Shows active contracts and milestones that need attention, with write actions confirmed by the user first.
